Messages.Author: ALEX HARMON
Messages.Body:
Some questions...

1)Can you choose which damage to reduce when using flesh of marble? For
example, a vamp takes 1 regular damage and 3 aggro. and decides to reduce
the 3 aggro. damage and take the 1 regular. Is this allowed (assuming
sup. pro.)?

2)Can you use kiss of ra against a blocking vamp after u have played
change of target?

3)How is Anarch Troublemaker played? If you wish to use either of its
effects must you use it as you bring it into play? or can you put it out
into play without triggering its effects until you so desire? if you can
leave it out as one of your cards and wish to use its effects must you do
so during your master phase or can you use it at any given time?

4)Did the ruling on Blood to Acid say that it was only in effect for the
first strike resolution of a round? or was it good for all of the strikes
in a round?

Thanks in advance...

Alex

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
In article <5mdsov$6...@netnews.upenn.edu>,
harm...@futures.wharton.upenn.edu (ALEX HARMON) wrote:
>
> Some questions...

>
> 1)Can you choose which damage to reduce when using flesh of marble? For
> example, a vamp takes 1 regular damage and 3 aggro. and decides to reduce
> the 3 aggro. damage and take the 1 regular. Is this allowed (assuming
> sup. pro.)?

Yes. During the heal damage step, all (unprevented) damage is reduced to one
point. You can choose which one point will remain.

> 2)Can you use kiss of ra against a blocking vamp after u have played
> change of target?

No. After Change of Target is played, there is no blocker.

> 3)How is Anarch Troublemaker played? If you wish to use either of its
> effects must you use it as you bring it into play? or can you put it out

No, you just bring it into play.

> into play without triggering its effects until you so desire? if you can

This is correct.

> leave it out as one of your cards and wish to use its effects must you do
> so during your master phase or can you use it at any given time?

It can only be used (tapped) during your untap phase, per VtES card text
(errata to Jyhad card text).

> 4)Did the ruling on Blood to Acid say that it was only in effect for the
> first strike resolution of a round? or was it good for all of the strikes
> in a round?

It is a one-strike effect. It applies only to the next strike resolution.
